slides.content: One recipe, every market: momentum = t-12..t-2 return everywhere; value = B/P (stocks/indices), 5-years-ago spot (commodities), 5yr excess-return reversal / UIP deviation (currencies), real yield (bonds). Clickable class cards.

Stylized per-class result strip: value +, momentum +, negative V-M correlation everywhere, combo dominates; Japan card: momentum weak there but value strong and combo fine - exactly what negative correlation predicts.
Two strategies, SR 0.4 each (mean 0.4, vol 1), correlation -0.6; 50/50 combo: sigma = sqrt(0.25+0.25+0.5*(-0.6)) = sqrt(0.2) = 0.447; SR = 0.4/0.447 = 0.894.
Value here correlates with value there; first PC separates V and M globally; funding-liquidity loadings: value + (3.8), momentum - (-3.2) once noise is diversified; post-1998 dynamics.
TS vs XS momentum; 2x2 literature table (FF/Lo-MacKinlay autocorrelation, JT cross-sectional, MOP fills TS m-predicts-n); most direct random-walk test; sign of own 12M return, 58 futures.
REAL AQR 1880-2017 trend Sharpe bars, class-filterable, 66 instruments nearly all positive (Germany 5yr 1.02 ... Cocoa 0.08).
MOP position sizing 40%/sigma: commodity sigma 30% -> 1.33x; bond sigma 6% -> 6.67x; equal ex-ante risk so every market votes equally.
REAL ten worst 60/40 drawdowns 1880-2015 vs trend (net of 2/20): +36.1% in 1929-32, +95.4% in 1973-74, +21.6% in GFC; positive in 8 of 10; the TSMOM smile (does best in extremes).
Trend minus 60/40: 95.4-(-30.6)=126.0; 21.6-(-30.5)=52.1 percentage points. Crisis alpha quantified.

Impulse response: ~12 months continuation then partial reversal (under- then over-reaction); speculators ride trends, hedgers pay; roll returns (hedging pressure) persist, price-change component reverses.

Why betting markets: idiosyncratic bets (no risk premium possible) + terminal date reveals truth independent of beliefs. Three contracts with exact payoffs: spread ($110->210/110/0 at -N), moneyline, over/under; the vig.

H1-H4 framework (beta1, betaT); finding: strong momentum in line moves open->close, COMPLETELY reversed by game end = overreaction/mispricing; value weaker, size zero; effects 1/5 financial size; no covariance structure; Fama & Thaler quotes.

Uncertainty interaction (momentum stronger with uncertainty, value with less - matches DHS/Rabin, replicated in US equities); the vig as limits to arbitrage; what transfers to finance and what doesn't.
